item.description:
• New Notetaker page (beta): record a meeting or import a recording, then ask Notely anything about it.
  • The details: people, dates, numbers, decisions, action items and open questions, pulled out for you.
  • What did I miss?: catch up on any part of a meeting, even while it's still going.
  • Summaries in four lengths, and tasks that use your meetings, like updating a plan from last week's calls.
  • Connect AI tools: let Claude, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code and other MCP tools read the meetings you choose.
